facts.business: Rajesh Power Services Limited is a leading EPC solutions provider in India's power transmission and distribution sector, offering comprehensive turnkey solutions for transmission lines, substations, underground cable systems, distribution networks, MVCC projects, and related infrastructure.

auditor.name: M/s Dinesh R. Thakkar & Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: First annual standalone financial statements prepared in accordance with Ind AS; comparative information for year ended 31 March 2025 and opening Balance Sheet as at 1 April 2024 have been restated in accordance with Ind AS.

key_risks: Revenue recognition in long-term EPC contracts using input method under Ind AS 115 involves significant estimation of construction contract costs and contract revenue
Higher receivables aligned with increased business scale and project execution
Decrease in debtors turnover ratio due to higher receivables
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances given to related parties amounted to Rs 624.17 lakhs (91.96% of total outstanding) as at 31 March 2026, compared to Rs 1,310.78 lakhs (97.46%) as at 31 March 2025. The Company participates in supplier finance arrangements with participating banks where banks make payment directly to approved suppliers on invoice due date, with the Company settling amounts due within 60-120 days. Financial liabilities forming part of supplier finance arrangements were Rs 8,647.47 lakhs as at 31 March 2026.
